name: Anime & Asian Media Hub
description: Curated sources specializing in Anime, Manga, Raw media, and broader East Asian content (Japanese/Chinese/Korean).
author: Kiyomi Anime Curators

providers.name: Nyaa
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Primary source for Eastern Asian media, often featuring raw or fan-subbed content.

providers.name: Anime Tosho
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Automated mirror service for anime torrents using native JSON endpoints with aids and qx search support.
providers.cautionReason: Feed/API servers reported offline; requires active mirror or local proxy fallback.

providers.name: TsukiHime
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Modern anime indexer and release tracker built with a native v1 REST API.

providers.name: SeaDex
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Curated index of the best available anime releases, encodes, and dual-audio batches.

providers.name: Torrentio
providers.author: Torrentio
providers.description: Multi-source torrent streaming aggregator for anime, movies, and TV series, with configurable filtering and support for multilingual and adult content.

providers.name: SubsPlease
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Direct source for fast, high-quality weekly anime simulcasts in 1080p, 720p, and SD.

providers.name: Yameii (Dubs)
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: English dub uploads from Yameii on nyaa.si. Single-uploader source, highly consistent quality.

providers.name: ToonsHub
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: ToonsHub releases on nyaa.si. Title-prefix filter for the [ToonsHub] group. Wide coverage of currently-airing shows.

providers.name: AniLibria
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Official AniLibria v1 JSON API provider for Russian dubbed and subbed anime releases.

providers.name: Bangumi.moe
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Open Asian and Chinese anime fansub aggregation platform with high-speed indexing.

providers.name: ACG.RIP
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Indexes Chinese and broader Asian media collections.

providers.name: TokyoTosho
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: General Eastern media index, including Anime, Manga, and non-video media.
providers.cautionReason: Non-video content (e.g., games, software, archives) may contain malware.

providers.name: Mikan Project
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Dedicated indexer for Japanese animation, known for fast release indexing.

providers.name: AnimeTime
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: RSS feed focusing on dual-audio, multi-subbed anime releases.

providers.name: Anirena
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Provides simple RSS search results primarily for anime content.

providers.name: NekoBT
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Specialized private anime indexer providing high-quality torrents via a Torznab API.

providers.name: Sukebei Nyaa
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Adults-only sister site of Nyaa, focused on 18+ Japanese/Asian media.

providers.name: EZTV
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Specialized television tracker offering scene releases and season packs.

providers.name: Knaben
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Modern, fast search API that offers structured results.

providers.name: BTDigg
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Global search engine utilizing the DHT network; excellent for locating older, large, or rare Asian media archives.
providers.cautionReason: Search results are often unverified and may contain malicious files.

providers.name: CloudTorrents
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Modern API-based indexer; useful for locating structured results when main Anime trackers fail.

providers.name: Snowfl
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: General meta-search engine providing results from multiple sources; great for cross-checking niche Asian media titles.
providers.cautionReason: External meta-search results can be unverified.

providers.name: UIndex
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Indexes torrents with magnet URLs across Anime, Movies, TV, and Asian media.

providers.name: TorrentDownload
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Public indexer for TV shows, anime, movies, and music.

providers.name: BitSearch
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Fast DHT crawler indexing torrents across all categories via public JSON API.

providers.name: FileMood
providers.author: Kiyomi Community
providers.description: Scrapes FileMood torrent search engine with offset-based pagination and status metrics.
